sources.snippet: A complete implementation of LeWorldModel (LeWM), the JEPA-based world model from LeCun et al. (2026), trained on the PushT manipulation task with a CEM planner for goal-conditioned control. LeWM is a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world model that learns latent dynamics from pixels.
